purpose: Verified 20-record batch 114 from the clean 281-record reference-dependent queue. spells/stasis-clone-1522.name: Stasis Clone
spells/stasis-clone-1522.effectSummary: Functions as clone, but if the original creature is still alive when the duplicate matures, the duplicate enters stasis and does not decay. When the original later dies, its soul transfers to the stasis clone and the body activates under the normal clone rules. If several stasis clones exist, the soul enters the most recently created one.
spells/stasis-clone-1522.notes: Manually source-reviewed and digest-locked. Batch 114 stays deliberately small because the residual queue is increasingly dominated by table-driven, stat-block, legacy-inheritance, and source-damage cases.

spells/mindrape-165.name: Mindrape

Severe personality or alignment changes can be corrected by break enchantment, possibly followed by atonement; altered memories and subtler thought changes require miracle or wish.

spells/spell-theft-896.name: Spell Theft

Only dispellable effects can be stolen, and attempts automatically fail for spells for which you are not a legal target.

spells/sever-legacy-3525.name: Sever Legacy
spells/sever-legacy-3525.effectSummary: Permanently breaks one creature's bond to its legacy items on a failed Will save. It is treated as not having completed the item's legacy rituals and loses Least Legacy, Lesser Legacy, and Greater Legacy feats without recovering previously paid personal costs. If its Hit Dice exceed your caster level, the difference adds to its save; a successful save grants 24-hour immunity. Access can be restored by performing the rituals again without repaying already-paid personal costs, or the spell can be undone by miracle or wish.

spells/translocation-trick-1803.name: Translocation Trick
spells/translocation-trick-1803.effectSummary: Swaps your location with one creature at medium range and disguises each of you as the other for 10 minutes per caster level. The target can Will-save to negate; the spell fails if either body exceeds dimension door capacity or the forms are too different for alter self to imitate. True seeing and similar magic reveal identities. Both creatures gain the normal disguise interaction, and you receive +10 on Disguise checks to impersonate the target. When the spell ends, appearances revert but locations do not swap back.

spells/spell-snare-4853.name: Spell Snare
spells/spell-snare-4853.effectSummary: For 10 minutes per caster level, enchants an Eberron dragonshard held by its bearer. The next single-target spell or spell-like ability of 3rd level or lower, including an orb or ray, that targets the bearer is automatically absorbed with no effect and the shard disintegrates. It triggers on harmful or beneficial magic alike and requires no action. Only one spell snare can benefit a bearer; carrying several causes all to trigger on the first qualifying spell. Material component: a dragonshard worth at least 25 gp, consumed when it absorbs magic.

spells/glyph-of-warding-2326.name: Glyph of Warding
spells/glyph-of-warding-2326.effectSummary: Permanently wards an area or object with configurable entry or opening conditions based on passwords, physical characteristics, creature type, subtype or kind, alignment, or religion, but not class, Hit Dice, or level. The nearly invisible glyph can be dispelled and identified with read magic and Spellcraft. A blast glyph deals 1d8 damage per two caster levels, maximum 5d8, in a 5-foot radius using a chosen acid, cold, fire, electricity, or sonic type, Reflex half. A spell glyph stores one harmful spell of 3rd level or lower and delivers it to the intruder under normal save and spell-resistance rules. Material component: incense and diamond powder worth at least 200 gp.

spells/shadowfade-1864.name: Shadowfade

It is invisible from the Material Plane and appears as a white hole from the Plane of Shadow. It can be cast only on a plane coexistent with Shadow and not on the Plane of Shadow itself.
